chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 209: Xiao Chen Slays Half-Gods and Flees to the Southern Wastes
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen's vengeful rampage against the Tiger and Hai families leaves half-gods dead. But his hollow victory leads him to a vision of his lost home. A tragic turning point in the World of Immortality.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 209: Slaughter of Half-Gods and a Dream of Home
og_description: Xiao Chen tears through half-gods with divine artifacts, but revenge rings hollow. Exhausted, he crashes into a vision of his mortal home—a poignant end to the Heavenly Emperor City arc.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen kills half-gods and flees south, only to be haunted by a vision of home. A devastating chapter in the World of Immortality.
